_note: A feat's prerequisite as a class feature's choice reads it (#384).
Invocations write theirs in prose. Two shapes are enforced: "Level N+
<Class>" is the level in that class ("Level N+" alone, the total), and
"<Name> Invocation" is a feat held or picked in the same answer. The rest
("a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage") is shown and never judged.
Go has the rule in internal/http/feat_prereqs.go, TypeScript in
lib/featureChoices.ts (prereqUnmet); both answer these cases. `levels` are
by lowercased class name, `has` the feats counted as held, and `unmet` the
reason, empty when the readable part holds.
